sources.title: Models | Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: Exact ID listed as Aion 3.0 Mini: released 2026-05-14, DeepSeek-family collaborative multi-model generation, narrative focus, 128K context, reasoning. No component identities, parameter counts, or neural architecture disclosed.

sources.title: Aion Labs public models API
sources.evidence: Exact entry aion-labs/aion-3.0-mini reports date 2026-05-14, context_length 131072, modality text->text, reasoning true and tool_calls true. No parameter counts or downloadable weights are provided.

sources.title: API Reference | Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: Documents model capability fields and explicitly includes Aion 3.0 Mini among models supporting reasoning_effort none, low, medium, high and max; default medium. Explains that created timestamps correspond to release dates.

sources.title: Terms of Service of the Aion Labs API, version 2026-10-17
sources.evidence: Defines Models by the official Models page. Section 6 reserves service/software property to Aion Labs or licensors and grants no rights in Models beyond service use. It is an API service agreement, not a downloadable weight license.

sources.title: Models.dev Aion-3.0-Mini record
sources.evidence: Baseline provenance: generic efficiency/automation description, closed weights, 2026-05-14 date, text modalities, reasoning, tools, and 131072 context. Its comment attributes the date to the official API.

sources.title: Aion-3.0-Mini - API Pricing & Providers
sources.evidence: Uses the baseline hyphenated display name and exact ID, describes the DeepSeek-based collaborative storytelling system, and reports July 7, 2026 as Released, conflicting with the original developer date. Used to record the discrepancy, not override developer evidence.

name.note: Same exact identifier; Aion Labs styles the name Aion 3.0 Mini, while the serving provider uses Aion-3.0-Mini.

developer.note: Official developer documentation and service brand establish Aion Labs.

family.note: Explicitly built on the DeepSeek family. The particular component checkpoints are not named.

release_date.note: Developer documentation and API agree on May 14. OpenRouter reports July 7; retain the original developer date and record this discrepancy.

open_weights.note: Published as a hosted service; the applicable terms grant only service use of the listed Models. No weight release is identified in the reviewed official material.

license.note: No separate model/weight license identified. API use is governed by the Aion Labs service terms.

parameters_b.note: No total count disclosed for this exact multi-model system. No DeepSeek base-model count is transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active count or component activation accounting disclosed.

architecture.note: Collaborative multi-model generation is disclosed, but underlying neural architecture and component topology are not. The API architecture object describes modality only; dense or MoE cannot be assigned.

context_window.note: Exact context_length from the developer endpoint, in tokens.

reasoning.note: The model reports reasoning=true; the documentation specifies its reasoning controls.

tool_call.note: The exact model entry reports tool_calls=true, defined as accepting tools and returning tool calls.

description.value: DeepSeek-based collaborative multi-model system for narrative generation and storytelling
description.note: Replaces unsupported efficiency, latency, extraction and automation positioning with the developer-described design and narrative focus.

patch.description: DeepSeek-based collaborative multi-model system for narrative generation and storytelling
patch.notes: Aion Labs describes a collaborative system using multiple DeepSeek-family models, without identifying component checkpoints or disclosing total/active parameter counts or neural architecture. Its official release date is 2026-05-14; OpenRouter lists 2026-07-07.

summary: Corrects the generic description and identifies DeepSeek lineage. Confirms official release date, context, text-only modalities, reasoning and tool calling. Total and active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed; multi-model composition is not evidence for a particular DeepSeek size or MoE topology. Records conflicting OpenRouter date.
